name: chatcut-desktop
description: AI video editing in ChatCut: install and connect the signed ChatCut Desktop app so Codex can edit videos, add captions, and recreate viral videos with your own footage.

interface.longDescription: Edit videos with AI in ChatCut. Ask in your own words to cut footage, add captions and subtitles, clean up a talking-head recording, add B-roll, music and motion graphics, or recreate a viral video's shots and pacing with your own footage, and get an editable timeline you can review. This plugin installs, opens, connects, or repairs the signed ChatCut Desktop app, which provides the video-editing tools and skills and keeps the project on your computer.
defaultPrompt: Recreate this viral video with my own footage, keeping its shots and pacing.
Cut this talking-head video tighter and add captions.
Add subtitles to my video and export a vertical version.
